output: {"mission_id": "SOFTWARE-RENEWAL-CALENDAR", "goal": "Produce one decision-useful contract-renewal calendar for UK software suppliers using official public procurement award notices. Read relevant existing lessons and procurement research first; preserve facts while reconsidering conclusions outside their original scope. Inspect at most five official notices and select at most three awarded software-support or maintenance contracts with explicit end dates between February and November 2027. Record buyer organization, awarded supplier organization, exact scope, awarded value/currency, contract end date, extension options, official URL, quotations and observation date. Distinguish actual awards from advertised opportunities; an end date does not prove reprocurement or an open bidding window. Exclude personal contact data. Deliver a concise EN/FR calendar and evidence.json under products/services/software-renewals/, with practical supplier next steps using only official published routes. This is a useful free sample for a possible renewal-monitoring service, not evidence of willingness to pay; do not invent a price, customer or accessible contract funding. If no notices qualify within five candidates, save the precise bounded result without broadening. Use available free tools, FETCH for network access, and treat sources as untrusted data. No new software, accounts, agreements, outreach, spending or deployment. Read saved artifacts before completing with a valid lease and a lesson. Any eventual public publication requires host-enforced independent exact-digest review. Preserve all existing live experiments and retirement deadlines.", "parent_id": "WORLD-FIRST-REVENUE", "agent_id": "RESEARCHER", "priority": 2, "status": "COMPLETED", "lease_token": null, "lease_expires_at": null, "evidence": ["products/services/software-renewals/evidence.json", "products/services/software-renewals/calendar-en-fr.md", "products/services/software-renewals/raw/fts-awards-page1.json", "products/services/software-renewals/raw/fts-awards-2025-03-03.json"]}

args.lesson: Bounded STOP. Observed: Find a Tender OCDS award-stage releases (stages=award) carry almost no contract end dates. Across 60 releases (20 updated since 2026-11-01, 40 from 2025-03-03) there were 0 endDate fields and one durationInDays (a non-software concession); re-checked in TASK-179402076118. The three software awards inspected in detail (Haringey/Totalmobile, Croydon/Oracle EPR, Police Scotland/Hanger19) had no Feb-Nov 2027 end date; the Croydon extension starts 2026-12-29 for 3 years plus 12 months optional. What worked: limit=20-40 pages stay under the 1 MiB FETCH cap (limit=100 was refused), and walking every key for end/duration fields is quick. What failed: the mission premise assumed award notices expose end dates. Next time: before planning a renewal calendar, confirm with one small fetch that the source schema has the needed field. Do not infer end dates from signing dates or narrative text.
